SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE

REPORT

File No. MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REG. S.
7486
Date July 8, 1936.

Subject (in full) David Dohse

Issue by C.A. Cook Forwarded by D.S. Lees

Sir,

I beg to report that the German named David Dohse,
who fled from Shanghai some ten years ago, having been
implicated in defrauding certain fire insurance companies, has
returned to Shanghai and has been recognized by several who
know him.

Dohse's brother is acting chief of the local
Nazis organization pro tem until the return of Ishmann.

John Hoer
Clerical Assistant.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
S. 3，特别股。
报告

档案编号 警务处
特别股登记册 S.
7486
日期 1936年7月8日。

事由（全称） 大卫·多斯（David Dohse）

由 C.A. Cook 签发 经 D.S. Lees 转呈

先生：

谨此报告，德国人大卫·多斯（David Dohse）约十年前因牵涉诈骗多家火灾保险公司而逃离上海，现已返回上海，并被数名认识他的人认出。

多斯的兄弟在伊什曼（Ishmann）（音译）回来之前，暂时代理当地纳粹组织的首领职务。

约翰·霍尔（John Hoer）
文书助理。

特别股主管警官。
